name: @feliperun/skills
description: Reusable skills for agent work with a small control-plane context.

scripts.check: for f in bin/*.mjs .claude/hooks/*.mjs skills/mine/intent-factory/src/*.mjs skills/mine/intent-factory/src/*/*.mjs skills/mine/intent-factory/src/*/*/*.mjs skills/mine/intent-factory/bin/*.mjs skills/mine/intent-factory/evals/*.mjs skills/mine/intent-factory/test/*.mjs skills/mine/intent-factory/test/*/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
